description: GAC Reservations v1 — a mobile-first, auth-gated room/hall booking system for Gawargious & Ava Antonious. Members browse room schedules, check availability, and submit booking requests; admins approve/reject from a queue. Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui, backed by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, RLS) via supabase-js and raw SQL migrations.

userStories.title: Scaffold Next.js 15 app with Tailwind and shadcn/ui
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the base app scaffold so every feature has somewhere to live.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 15 App Router project created with TypeScript
Tailwind CSS configured and applied to a global stylesheet
shadcn/ui initialized (components.json present, at least Button component installed)
Root layout renders a placeholder home page that builds
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Scaffolded Next.js 15.5.20 (App Router, TS) with Tailwind v4 and shadcn/ui (base-nova style, Button installed) via create-next-app + shadcn init; placeholder home page renders Button; npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run build all pass; verified dev server serves 200 with expected markup.

userStories.title: Wire up Supabase client and environment variables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need browser and server Supabase clients so the app can talk to Postgres and Auth.
acceptanceCriteria: Add .env.local.example with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, and server-only SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
Create a browser supabase client helper and a server supabase client helper using supabase-js / @supabase/ssr
Service role key is only ever read in server-side code, never exposed to the client bundle
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Installed @supabase/supabase-js, @supabase/ssr, server-only. Added .env.local.example (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY). Added lib/supabase/client.ts (browser), lib/supabase/server.ts (per-request server client via @supabase/ssr + next/headers cookies), and lib/supabase/admin.ts (service-role client guarded by the 'server-only' import so it can't land in a client bundle). Typecheck and lint pass.

userStories.title: SQL migration for rooms, bookings, and profiles tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core schema so bookings can be stored.
acceptanceCriteria: Version-controlled SQL migration file creates rooms (id, name, capacity, amenities, location, rules, created_at)
Creates bookings (id, room_id FK, user_id FK, date, start_time, end_time, service, notes, status, reject_reason, created_at, updated_at)
Creates profiles (id FK auth.users, display_name, role default 'member', created_at)
bookings.status constrained to 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'cancelled' via enum or CHECK
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added supabase/migrations/20260719000000_create_core_schema.sql creating booking_status enum, rooms, profiles, and bookings (with FKs to auth.users, end_time>start_time check, and room/date + user_id indexes). Typecheck passes (no TS changes; SQL-only story).

userStories.title: SQL migration for Row-Level Security policies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need RLS so data access is enforced at the database layer, not just the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: RLS enabled on rooms, bookings, and profiles
rooms: any authenticated user may SELECT; no member INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
bookings: members SELECT/UPDATE only their own rows; INSERT only where user_id = auth.uid() and status = 'pending'; only role='admin' may set status to 'approved'/'rejected'
profiles: a user may read/update only their own profile; role is not self-service editable
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added supabase/migrations/20260719000100_add_rls_policies.sql: enables RLS on rooms/bookings/profiles; rooms readable by any authenticated user with no member write policies; bookings select/insert/update scoped to user_id = auth.uid() with insert requiring status='pending' and member updates blocked from setting approved/rejected; a security-definer is_admin() plus an admin-only update policy lets only role='admin' transition status to approved/rejected; profiles select/update scoped to own id, with a BEFORE UPDATE trigger blocking role self-edits unless done via the service_role key. Typecheck passes (SQL-only story, no TS changes).

userStories.title: Profile-on-signup trigger and seed script
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a profiles row auto-created on signup and sample data for local testing.
acceptanceCriteria: SQL trigger inserts a profiles row with default role 'member' when a new auth user is created
Seed script inserts at least 3 sample rooms
Seed script creates (or promotes) at least 1 admin profile for testing
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added supabase/migrations/20260719000200_profile_on_signup_trigger.sql (handle_new_user() + on_auth_user_created trigger inserting a profiles row with default role 'member'). Added supabase/seed.sql seeding 4 sample rooms and one admin user (admin@gac-reservations.local) inserted directly into auth.users/auth.identities and promoted to role='admin'. Also added supabase/config.toml and supabase/.gitignore (local Supabase CLI project init). Verified end-to-end with `npx supabase db reset` against local Docker Postgres: 4 rooms present, admin profile promoted correctly, and a freshly inserted auth.users row confirms the trigger defaults new signups to role='member'. npx tsc --noEmit passes.

userStories.title: Login, signup, and logout with Supabase Auth
userStories.description: As a member, I want to log in and out so I can access the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Login and signup pages authenticate against Supabase Auth (email/password)
Successful login persists the session across a page refresh
A logout action ends the session and returns to the login page
Invalid credentials show a clear error message
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added app/login (page + server action), app/signup (page + server action), and app/logout (server action) using lib/supabase/server's cookie-based client; home page (app/page.tsx) now checks auth.getUser() and shows Log in/Sign up links or a Signed-in-as + Log out form. Added shadcn Input/Label/Card components for the forms. Invalid credentials redirect back to /login?error=... and render a role=alert message. Verified end-to-end against local Supabase (db reset applied) with a Playwright script driving a real browser: signup -> signed-in home, session persists across reload, logout -> /login, invalid login shows error, valid login signs in. npx tsc --noEmit and npm run lint both pass.
